rationale: The supplied verse 75/38 reproduces the example exactly: ʕAbər yatu mbalašle šoʕəl w mʕaṭəš w mʕaraṭle, with the same translation. Verse 115/311 instead concerns arriving home, a distressed man and a woman offering to sacrifice sons for Gorgis; it contains neither this example nor an occurrence of mbalaš. Remove that reference while retaining the already correct 75/38; no replacement verse is conjectured.
